title: Internship For Data Analyst
job_description:
What We’re Looking For Diploma/Degree student in Data Analytics, IT, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or related fields Interested in AI tools, automation & business technology Comfortable using ChatGPT or other AI tools in daily tasks Familiar with Excel / Google Sheets Knowledge in Power BI, SQL, Python, or automation tools is a bonus Curious mindset, willing to learn & explore new ideas Able to adapt in a fast-moving environment

Love AI, Data & Smart Workflows? We’re looking for a curious and tech-savvy Data Analysis Intern to join our growing F&B team! If you enjoy using AI tools, analyzing data, building reports, and finding smarter ways to work — this internship is for you. This role heavily uses AI tools in daily work, from reporting and data analysis to automation and operational support. You’ll gain real exposure to how AI is transforming business operations in the F&B industry. What You’ll Be Doing Analyze sales, manpower, and outlet performance data Build reports, dashboards, and business insights for management Use AI tools to speed up reporting and automate workflows Identify trends, problems, and improvement opportunities Support digitalization and automation projects Work closely with HR, Operations, Finance & Marketing teams Turn messy data into useful business decisions Why Join Us? Real AI-powered working environment Exposure to fast-growing F&B operations Learn practical business analytics skills Young, energetic & supportive team culture Opportunity to contribute real ideas & improvements Gain experience beyond classroom learning

Training Provided Allowance Provided 5 Working Days Employee Discount on company products/services Unlimited Supply Pantry Food Fun Entertainment Environment

Data Analysis Statistical Analysis Data Visualization
